# Version 4.152.0
> **Vulkan expansion and memory-leak fixes** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 bumps to Skia milestone m152 and adds a Silk.NET-backed Vulkan package. Ships several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes, adds FreeType-based Nano Server font support, and converts all solutions to the .slnx format.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m152, plus a follow-up servicing sync and further m151 stability fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — Adds a Silk.NET-backed Vulkan interop package, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface for asynchronous, backend-neutral pixel reads. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed several native use-after-free and leak issues** — Roots the SKRegion in SpanIterator to fix a use-after-free, roots the pixel source in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* methods, and fixes a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in the SKImage.Create raster failure path. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Reduced allocations in more hot paths** — Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, and avoids a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))

## Platform

- **FreeType-based Nano Server font support** — Adds FreeType-backed font support for Windows Nano Server, and initializes the MSVC environment once per native build to speed up Windows builds. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska), [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))
- **Deterministic binding generation** — Makes binding generation deterministic across platforms, and adds containerized Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server test legs. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612), [#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Converts the HarfBuzzSharp solution to .slnx format and adds containerized test legs to broaden platform coverage for the binding.

Opened the 4.152.0 line with the Skia m152 milestone bump, the new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes, and FreeType-based Nano Server font support.
